title: Compliance-surveillance team - review findings pack
description: The structured source of truth for a review/audit report. On disk the pack is JSONL (one envelope line + one line per finding, scripts/findings_pack_io.py) so appending more findings is a safe line-append, never a JSON-array patch; this schema validates the dict reconstructed by findings_pack_io.read_pack, not a raw file parse - format is otherwise unchanged from the object shape below. scripts/render_findings.py renders it to the canonical REVIEW-<slug>.md; scripts/validate_findings.py enforces this schema. The model supplies field VALUES; the renderer owns the FORMAT - so a finding can never drift (5C/C-word/inline). Narrative sections are string fields so the whole report renders from one pack. ONE shared schema across every pack-emitting reviewer, distinguished by 'kind': code-reviewer (review, security-audit), performance-reviewer (performance), compliance-reviewer (compliance), model-validator (model-validation). Those four hold Write and Edit, both scoped (mechanically enforced by guard-findings-pack-write.py) to their own findings-pack path only: they author artifacts/<slug>/data/findings-<slug>.jsonl (or the flat artifacts/data/ path) directly and return a distilled summary to the PM, not the pack itself; check_artifacts --fix validates and renders whatever they wrote.

slug.description: kebab-case id; drives the artifact filename

kind.description: which review kind - drives the rendered artifact's prefix (REVIEW- / SECURITY-AUDIT- / PERF-) and title. Defaults to 'review' if omitted. 'compliance' and 'model-validation' have no prefix mapping in render_findings/check_artifacts yet, so they fall back to REVIEW-<slug>.md: give those packs a slug prefixed 'compliance-' / 'model-validation-' so they cannot collide with a code-review pack of the same engagement.

commit.description: the reviewed commit SHA, if known

methodology.description: how the review was performed (lenses/passes, standards applied) - the audit skeleton's Method section

scoring.description: scoring provenance - who scored/filtered this pack's findings. For the scored kinds (review, security-audit, performance) the DoD gate (PACK-UNSCORED, scripts/check_artifacts.py) requires a recorded review-scorer pass here, e.g. 'scored by review-scorer: Found 12 · Reported 9 · Filtered 3'; a self-scoring note alone does not satisfy it, because the scorer runs even after self-scoring (docs/code-review-method.md). render_findings surfaces the Found/Reported/Filtered numbers as a prominent transparency line - it prefers the explicit 'found'/'reported'/'filtered' integers below, and falls back to parsing them out of this string, so this line's 'Found N · Reported R · Filtered F' wording is load-bearing

found.description: false-positive transparency (optional): total candidate issues seen before filtering. Surfaced by render_findings as the prominent 'Found N · Reported R · Filtered F' line; when omitted the renderer recovers the numbers from the 'scoring' string

reported.description: false-positive transparency (optional): issues reported (defaults to the number of findings in the pack when omitted)

filtered.description: false-positive transparency (optional): issues seen and set aside below threshold or as noise - a count, with the per-item reasons carried in 'scoring'

verdict.description: free-text verdict; wording varies by kind (e.g. 'conditional', 'audit-ready', 'scales to target', 'won't scale')

dod_status.description: compliance packs: the Definition-of-Done verdict per applicable item (met / not met + the evidence relied on). Not yet emitted by render_findings - carried in the pack so the detail is retained and auditable

tags.description: optional machine-filterable taxonomy labels (e.g. 'CWE-89', 'OWASP A03:2021', a rule id). The cited 'standard' remains the authoritative reference; these are the aggregation tags SARIF/Semgrep/CodeQL carry alongside it. Rendered as a Tags line on the finding and a Tags column in the at-a-glance table ONLY when present - never fabricated

effort.description: optional fix-effort / size estimate (e.g. 'S', 'M', 'L', '~15 min'), the SonarQube remediation-effort axis. Rendered on the finding's disposition line and in the at-a-glance table ONLY when present - never fabricated

problem.description: what is wrong + how we know (audit 'condition')

likely_cause.description: why the gap exists; never silent (audit 'cause')

current_cost.description: performance only: the current cost (e.g. '4.2s @ 100k rows')

projected_cost.description: performance only: cost after the fix
